obligations.behavior: Accumulate Direct and Winograd multi-stripe channel groups across INT8, INT16, and FP16 calculator latencies.

Resolve 1P SRAM read/write conflicts and RAW hazards across 8 RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x64_c2_bm_bist macros, gate extension banks in INT16/FP16, and deliver lossless backpressured SDP packets with alternating layer interrupts.

Place all 8 SRAM macros legally inside core bounds, constrain nvdla_core_clk <= 15.0 ns with >= 1.2 ns I/O delays, and close OpenROAD PDN, post-GRT WNS/hold >= 0.0 ns, overflow <= 15, and wirelength <= 2,650,000 um.
